# Bispecific Antibody Inpatient Administration (Oncology)

Note: The oncologist will see the patient in clinic the day prior to admission

for bispecific antibody treatment. The oncologist will enter the treatment

orders in VCM, our oncology-interfaced software. Once the patient is admitted

the oncology pharmacist will release the orders from VCM to CPRS.

# Please contact Hem-Onc on call for questions or concerns.
